[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed in SKILL.md and the implementation playbook: the OAuth callback redirects to the frontend with an access token in the URL. This is a real insecure implementation example, but it is documentation content rather than hidden agent behavior.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Confirmed: a bearer token exposed in a redirect URL could be replayed if copied into a real app. This warrants user caution and revision of the example, but does not show malicious behavior by the skill itself.
llm.guidance: Safe to install as a reference, but do not treat every snippet as production-ready. Replace the OAuth redirect-with-token pattern with a safer flow such as server-side session cookies or an authorization-code/PKCE-style exchange, and have any generated auth implementation reviewed before deployment.
llm.summary: This is a documentation-only authentication guide, but one OAuth example passes a login token through a URL and should not be copied into production.
